newsitem.title: USA: Peru official says business unscathed by crisis.
newsitem.headline: Peru official says business unscathed by crisis.

text.p: Peru First Vice President Ricardo Marquez said Thursday that his country's business climate has not been affected by the standoff at the Japanese ambassador's home in Lima, in which Marxist rebels have held 72 hostages since December.
"It has had no effect," he said at the beginning of an address to members of Miami's business community. "Everything is still the same."
Marquez was visiting Miami with a group of 20 executives from Peruvian textile and apparel companies to attend the Apparel Show of the Americas in the city March 19-21.
He said Peru is optimistic about its prospects for continued economic growth, and outlined plans including a program he said would generate 90,000 new jobs in the next 18 months.
"There is no reason not to have confidence in investment in Peru," he said.
